categories.purpose: Own categories feature behavior, read models, and UI contracts for the discovery context.

google-shopping-operations.purpose: Own the Discovery Google Shopping operator view, request client, filters, and route contracts for feed readiness diagnostics.
google-shopping-operations.allowedWhen: Allowed for admin-web operational surfaces that inspect Discovery-owned Google Shopping rows without exposing provider secrets.
google-shopping-operations.createdFor: Discovery Google Shopping Merchant Center integration milestone.

product-alerts.purpose: Own product-alerts behavior, read models, notification matching, APIs, and account UI for selected marketplace Products.
product-alerts.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

client-support.purpose: Provide reusable client-support assets shared by discovery-owned features and composition seams.
client-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one feature and cross-feature reuse is explicit.
client-support.justification: client-support centralizes context-local composition that should not duplicate across features.
client-support.createdFor: discovery workflows that span multiple features or public entrypoints.
client-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into feature-local modules.

google-shopping-support.purpose: Provide Discovery-owned Google Shopping export projection schema, row identity, eligibility, and payload hashing contracts.
google-shopping-support.allowedWhen: Allowed for public-discovery export behavior that projects Catalog and Marketplace facts into Google-facing rows without changing source ownership.
google-shopping-support.justification: Google Shopping rows are a provider-facing public discovery export and need stable contracts shared by projection, sync, and diagnostics slices.
google-shopping-support.createdFor: Discovery Google Shopping Merchant Center integration milestone.
google-shopping-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when Google Shopping export support is retired or moved into a dedicated provider integration context by ADR.

route-support.purpose: Provide the item-detail route adapter modules (loader, action, commerce builder, and route types) that orchestrate Discovery item detail route behavior.
route-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when route-layer behavior cannot stay inside the thin route module or a feature folder.
route-support.justification: route-support centralizes the item-detail route's loader/action orchestration and cross-context server-surface composition without mixing route adapter behavior into request support.
route-support.createdFor: the item-detail route, which composes Discovery item reads with Marketplace, Inventory, and Checkout server clients during loader and action handling.
route-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when the item-detail route no longer needs extracted loader/action modules.

realtime-support.purpose: Provide discovery-owned realtime topic contracts and registration metadata.
realtime-support.allowedWhen: Allowed for SSE topic contracts shared by discovery projectors, routes, and platform composition.
realtime-support.justification: realtime-support keeps discovery topic ownership in the discovery bounded context instead of deployables.
realtime-support.createdFor: SSE projection patch routing and topic construction for discovery marketplace surfaces.
realtime-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when discovery no longer publishes or consumes realtime projection patches.

ui-support.purpose: Expose browser-safe Discovery UI contracts for item-detail rail analytics without moving rail behavior out of the item-detail slice.
ui-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only for browser-safe Discovery UI contracts consumed through context web exports or item-detail UI.
ui-support.justification: The item-detail slice owns rail analytics vocabulary; the marketplace host needs the event allowlist without importing feature internals or duplicating bounded-context terms.
ui-support.sunsetWhen: Remove if rail analytics capture moves fully into deployable-owned instrumentation or an approved experimentation context.

ucp-support.purpose: Provide Discovery-owned Universal Commerce Protocol catalog adapters for public marketplace search and lookup.
ucp-support.allowedWhen: Allowed for standards-facing protocol adapters that map UCP catalog operations to Discovery-owned read models.
ucp-support.justification: ucp-support keeps catalog/search protocol mapping inside Discovery instead of deployables or a generic UCP bounded context.
ucp-support.createdFor: UCP catalog search and lookup over Discovery read models.
ucp-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when UCP catalog adapters move into generated context-owned transport composition.

routes.purpose: Expose discovery-owned route modules consumed by generated deployable adapters.
routes.allowedWhen: Required whenever the context contributes routes to any deployable.
